entries.summary: Restructure the cumulative patch notes into an enforced, area-grouped catalogue of differences from vanilla 0.G.
details: PATCHNOTES_ADDITIVE_0G.md drops commit ledgers, TODO markers, validation evidence, and fixes for defects this fork introduced and never shipped, falling from 896 to 386 lines.
Every difference now opens with a New, Improved, or Fixed tag measured against vanilla 0.G, and provenance stays in BACKPORTS.md while chronology stays in the generated CHANGELOG.md.
tools/patchnotes_lint.py enforces the closed section list, the tag vocabulary, and the line, entry, and section budgets in the Portable contracts gate.
AGENTS.md gains a documentation routing table and the patch-note editorial rules that the linter cannot check.
